summary: Verify Bluetooth can be toggled on from Connected devices settings
description: Regression test for the Bluetooth toggle in Connected devices settings. Confirms the toggle switches state and the 'On' status text appears. Requires real hardware; not exercised on the AAOS emulator.
preconditions: Device/emulator is powered on and unlocked
Test executed on real head unit hardware (Bluetooth radio unavailable on AAOS emulator)

testSteps.expectedResult: Connected devices screen opens showing a 'Bluetooth' toggle
Toggle switches to the On position
